summary: Iteration 15 testing completed for Email Settings Panel, Sidebar Badge Counts, Email Webhook, and Phone Search features. Backend: 18/18 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working.

backend: GET /api/sidebar/counts - returns new_leads and unread_chat counts
POST /api/leads/email-webhook - creates lead from SendGrid form data (PUBLIC, no auth)
GET /api/settings/email-templates - returns list of templates including lead_approved
PUT /api/settings/email-templates/lead_approved - updates template HTML and subject
POST /api/settings/email-templates/lead_approved/preview - returns rendered HTML with sample data
GET /api/leads?search=phone - finds leads by phone number
GET /api/leads?search=phone2 - finds leads by alternate phone (phone2)
POST /api/settings/email-templates/lead_approved/test-send - sends test email via SendGrid
frontend: Sidebar shows red badge with count next to Leads nav item (badge-new_leads)
Sidebar shows Chat nav item (badge appears when unread messages exist)
Admin Panel has Email Settings tab (5th tab after API Logs)
Email Settings - Sender Configuration section with sender_email, sender_name, company fields
Email Settings - Save Configuration button works
Email Settings - Email Templates section shows lead_approved template
Email Settings - Available Placeholders displayed (customer_name, quote_number, vehicle, etc.)
Email Settings - Preview button opens Email Template Preview dialog with rendered HTML
Email Settings - Edit button opens Template Editor dialog with subject and HTML textarea
Email Settings - Test email input and Send Test button work
Email Settings - Email Delivery Logs table shows sent emails with Time, To, Subject, Status
Leads page - Phone search finds leads by phone number
Leads page - Phone search finds leads by phone2 (alternate phone)

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/leads/email-webhook is correctly PUBLIC (no auth) for SendGrid Inbound Parse integration
Email webhook correctly parses key:value pairs from plain text body including phone2 field
GET /api/sidebar/counts correctly returns new_leads (unseen leads) and unread_chat counts
Email config and template endpoints correctly require superadmin role
Phone search in leads/quotes/orders correctly searches both phone and phone2 fields
Email template preview correctly renders placeholders with sample data
SendGrid integration is LIVE (not mocked) - test emails are actually sent
Layout.js correctly renders red badge with animate-pulse for new_leads and unread_chat counts
NotificationContext.js correctly fetches sidebar counts and handles chat_message SSE events
seed_data_creation: Test leads created via email webhook with TEST_ prefix for phone search testing
